svg.text: Identified customers (n=5,824); every buyer-month is new, retained (bought last month too) or resurrected (back after a gap).
Churned = bought last month, not this month. Quick ratio = (new + resurrected) / churned; >= 1 means the buyer base grew.
Mean month: 1,041 active = 212 new + 390 retained + 439 resurrected; 620 churn out. Overall quick ratio 1.05 (≥1 in 13 of 23 months).
Where the acquired base sits each month
All customers acquired by each month, stacked by stage. Neutral bands are the inactive stages; dormant = silent for more than 3 months (documented choice).
Where each stage's customers land next month
Aggregate month-to-month stage flows (customers, all complete month pairs). Ribbon width is proportional to customers; every ribbon and node is labeled with its count.
Impossible pairings (e.g. straight from an active month to dormant, or 'retained' after a silent month) are structural zeros of the stage definitions, not observations.
Complete months through 2011-11; the final data month is partial and excluded; stage definitions are documented choices (activity = any invoice in the month; dormancy threshold 3 months).
'New' is first purchase inside the window - the earliest months conflate truly-new buyers with pre-existing accounts (left-censoring). Identified customers only; measured, not modelled.
UCI Online Retail II · CC BY 4.0 · real transactions, Dec 2009 – Dec 2011
